snippet.title: Corrode // Official Map Trailer - VALORANT
snippet.description:
Brave the harsh beauty of the French castle turned mining town as you battle for its precious resources.  

New ground, classic energy.  This is Corrode.

Created in partnership with ARC Creative and ROSEWOOD Creative.

Music: Les Rêves D’hier (feat. Marylou Larson)

Written by David Donges, VERDAUNT
Produced by VERDAUNT
Mixed and mastered by David Donges
Performance by Marylou Larson
Music Supervision: Jonny Altepeter, Riot Games Music Team

Play VALORANT: https://riot.com/3idlntG
